record.title: Evaluate the stopped stock waveform and choose a bounded successor
record.intent: Resolve coherent sampled waveform/headroom before proposing further RF work.
requirements: Independently verify actual source framing/one-attempt evidence, capture/namespace/lease/epochs, full RAW geometry/preambles/count1, original parser/statistics and strict diagnostic headroom. Retain default receive rejection and separate diagnostic profile distinctly. Verify actual ordinary/export restoration and owned retirement/drop statistics or exact limitation.

Explain sampled periodicity, original-volts AC RMS/headroom and any commanded-frequency mismatch using existing numerical interpretation. Do not equate a transport-complete source write, builtin reading or sampled peak with device acknowledgement, calibrated RF fundamental/amplitude or analog bandwidth. Claim zero accepted original comparison slots.

Preserve all historical stopped Mac/Linux evidence. Continue only through an explicitly inspected/admitted bounded successor supported by the actual diagnostic outcome and remaining operator deadline. No automatic extra record/source retry, wider range, attenuation/wiring transition, reboot/native transition or 75-slot comparison is authorized by this decision.
acceptance: Actual diagnostic evidence or its precise limitation supports the smallest concrete next question.
